text:
sarah_m: Quick remediation cadence sync for the GPU/autoscale postmortem. Recurring pattern: short burst -> cold KV -> autoscaler lag -> scheduler reclaim. Need owners, short-term mitigations, and dates.

Tom_B: I can take the autoscaler sims. Plan: 24h replay with cold-cache windows to test cooldowns and scale thresholds. Will run two configs (current, conservative). ETA Tue EOD.

anya: I'll update the postmortem with the recurrence matrix (what repeats across events) and add the runbook steps for emergency headroom and tenant throttles. Draft by Monday.

leo_ops: For scheduler side: proposal to add "inference-low-latency" priorityClass and a reclaim rule to prefer preemption of batch jobs labeled "best-effort". I'll prototype kube config and start PR. ETA Wed.

olivia_pm: Monitoring request: add a pre-alert on allocation failures (failed_pod_alloc > 0 for 3m) and a metric for "scale_retries". We should block any threshold rollout until these alerts exist.

Tom_B: Simulator command (what I'm using):
```
./replay --trace traces/spike-2026-07.json --burst 5 --cold-kv
```

infra-bot: Heads-up: infra CI will run node-image updates Thurs 01:00-03:00 UTC. Avoid canary windows then.

anya: Short-term mitigation: soft per-tenant burst token bucket to throttle noisy tenants during spikes. I'll draft policy + customer message.

sarah_m: Owners summary to add to ticket: Tom_B -> sims & numbers (Tue), leo_ops -> scheduler PR (Wed), anya -> runbook + messaging (Mon), olivia_pm -> alert definitions (before canary). We'll reconvene Fri standup to review sims and decide canary. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
